runeborn.codex.armaments.body:
An armament deals up to five kinds of damage, scales with attributes on a grade from S down to E and has attribute requirements. Wield one without meeting them and its damage suffers badly.
Tempering stones reinforce standard armaments up to +25, lustrous stones reinforce legendary ones up to +10. Foes drop stones, with higher tiers deeper in the world, and the merchant sells them.
A whetstone infuses a standard armament with an affinity that reshapes its damage and scaling. Craft a blank whetstone, then combine it with reagents.
runeborn.codex.arts.body:
Every armament carries a weapon art. Unleash it with the art key. Arts cost FP and recover after a short cooldown.
Staves cast sorceries that scale with Intelligence, and sacred seals cast incantations that scale with Faith. A catalyst's art is its spell, and its spell power is shown in its tooltip.
runeborn.codex.attr.dexterity: Damage of quick and keen armaments.
runeborn.codex.attr.endurance: Maximum stamina, poise, and resistance to bleed and frost.
runeborn.codex.attr.faith: Incantations, holy and fire damage, and healing.
runeborn.codex.attr.intelligence: Sorceries, magic damage and magic warding.
runeborn.codex.attr.mind: Maximum FP, spent on weapon arts and spells.
runeborn.codex.attr.vigor: Maximum HP, and resistance to poison and blight.
runeborn.codex.attributes.body: Eight attributes shape a Runeborn. Each armament lists the attributes it requires and how strongly it scales with each one.
runeborn.codex.combat.body:
Attacks and dodges cost stamina, which recovers quickly once you stop. Fight exhausted and your blows weaken.
Dodge roll to slip through attacks, untouchable for a moment.
Status builds up with every hit and bursts when full. Bleed tears away a share of max HP, frost deals damage and leaves the foe slowed and vulnerable, poison and blight eat away over time.
runeborn.codex.controls.body: Keys can be changed in the game's controls menu, under Runeborn.
runeborn.codex.flasks.body:
The Ember Flask restores HP and the Azure Flask restores FP. Their charges refill whenever you rest at a shrine, and the Flasks service divides charges between the two.
Sunseeds add a charge and Hallowed Tears raise potency. Champions sometimes carry them, and every Sovereign does.
runeborn.codex.runes.body:
Runes are the currency of growth. Every foe you slay yields runes, more for foes of higher level and far more for champions and Sovereigns.
Spend runes at an Ember Shrine to raise an attribute by one. Your rune level is the sum of your attributes, and every level costs more than the last.
Shrine leveling is shared with RPG Attribute System, which must be installed too: every rune level you buy also grants RPG levels, whose points you spend in its own Level Up screen.
When you fall, the runes you carry stay where you died, marked by a green glow. Walk back to them to reclaim them. Fall again on the way and they are lost for good.
runeborn.codex.shrines.body:
Craft an Ember Shrine, place it and use it to kindle it. A kindled shrine takes a name from the land around it and is never forgotten.
Resting at a shrine restores HP and FP, refills your flasks and binds you to it, so you return there when you fall.
From a shrine you can level up, reinforce and infuse armaments, divide your flasks, travel to any kindled shrine, trade with the merchant, exchange relics, equip crown shards and seek rebirth.
runeborn.codex.sovereigns.body:
Combine six Sovereign Fragments, carried by champions, with a token to craft a sigil, then use the sigil to call its Sovereign before you.
A felled Sovereign leaves a relic, exchanged at a shrine for its legendary armaments, and a crown shard, a blessing you equip at a shrine. The Wither, the Ender Dragon, the Warden and the Elder Guardian guard relics of their own.
runeborn.codex.unknown: Fell this Sovereign to learn its blessing.
runeborn.codex.world.body:
The farther you roam from the world's spawn, the stronger foes become. The Nether and the End are far deadlier. A foe's level is shown above its health bar.
Champions bear affixes such as Ironclad, Frenzied or Phasing. They are dangerous, and they carry rich spoils: stones, Sovereign Fragments, runes, flask upgrades and armaments.

Runeborn levels you through RPG Attribute System.
Install RPG Attribute System alongside Runeborn to spend runes on attributes here. Every rune level you buy also grants RPG levels, whose points you spend in its own Level Up screen.
Until then, your origin's attributes carry you: reinforce, infuse and hunt Sovereigns as usual.
